title: System-Viz Filesystem Coverage MS1 — re-walks, drift detection, truncation recovery
brief: Follow-up to SYSTEM-VIZ-FS-COVERAGE-MS0 (shipped 2026-05-15 — 1.57M files / 70 namespaces). MS0 froze a snapshot; MS1 keeps the graph honest. Phase 0: re-walk the 3 namespaces flagged truncated in MS0 (.claude/H:/prism/.claude @ 20k cap, JM DIE @ 80k cap, Docustrata @ 80k cap) with raised caps. Phase 1: cron-driven daily re-walk of the top-N most-churned namespaces. Phase 2: drift detector (graph fsCoverage.lastWalkedAt vs disk dir mtimes) that surfaces stale namespaces + suggests re-walk targets.

closeout.summary: Phase 0 shipped 2026-05-15. Phase 1+2 deliverables verified on disk: cron-revwalk.mjs, namespace-churn-ranker.mjs (33/33 tests pass), detect-system-viz-drift.mjs (runs + writes DRIFT_REPORT.json), /system-viz-drift skill, stop-system-viz-drift.mjs (wired in settings.json). U-MS1-CRON-RUNNER finished this session — scheduled task 'PRISM System-Viz Re-walk Daily' registered via install-system-viz-revwalk-task.ps1 (daily 03:15, state=Ready, nextRun 2026-05-23).
closeout.followup_finding: detect-system-viz-drift.mjs reports 0 fsCoverage namespaces in the current system-graph.json — the L12 filesystem augmentation from MS0/MS1-Phase0 is no longer present in the live graph (regeneration drift). cron-revwalk re-walks EXISTING ranked namespaces and cannot bootstrap from empty; a fresh expand-system-viz-l12-files.mjs full walk is needed to re-populate fsCoverage. Tracked as a separate follow-up, not an MS1 unit gap.

scope_note: MS0 declared every H: file represented BUT 3 namespaces hit the safety cap and are flagged truncated. MS1 (a) recovers those, (b) institutes a cron cadence so the snapshot stays current, (c) detects drift between graph and disk so an operator (or chat) knows when a re-walk is overdue.

2.title: Drift detection — graph vs disk reality

units.title: scripts/detect-system-viz-drift.mjs — diffs fsCoverage.lastWalkedAt against current dir mtimes, flags >24h stale + >5% file-count delta
Skill: /system-viz-drift surfaces the latest drift report inline
Stop hook: stop-system-viz-drift.mjs — once per session, if drift report >12h old or >10 stale namespaces, nudge a refresh
